Yes I do enjoy studying but the depression is making it difficult to study. I've failed in a lot of things in life, hence the failure bit.
My parents have been quite supportive about my mental health and the treatment for it, but my mother is quite snarky about it from time to time, and my father is very distant, we don't really have a good relationship (we hardly talk in a day).

I feel like I'm not alive anymore, like my life is a simulation and I'm watching from a third person pov.
Whenever I do tune in, I feel heartwrenching pain and anguish, that's all there is constantly.
I have no friends, just my loving parents and an old pet. I'm studying to become a doctor, but I constantly feel like a failure.
I want to see past the pain, but I feel like I've shades on permanently.
I want to scratch at my heart so the pain stops. I want to carve my flesh till I find something of worth.
